SIX STARS 🤩
Oct 2026 • Friends
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

A truly great restaurant with excellent food and a very pleasant atmosphere! The dishes were fresh, tasted very good, and were beautifully presented. The price-performance ratio is also absolutely right.

A special compliment goes to our waiter "Bi". He was extremely friendly, attentive, and professional. You felt very welcome from the very beginning. Abi gave us very good advice, was attentive at all times without being intrusive, and made the visit even more pleasant with his likable manner.

Such good service really makes a difference. Many thanks to Abi and the entire team at DE THAM Restaurant – we would love to come back! 🇻🇳❤️
